questions.stem: A 45-year-old woman with a history of major depressive disorder is admitted to the psychiatric ward following a recent suicide attempt. Despite being on multiple antidepressant medications, her depressive symptoms have not improved. Her psychiatrist is considering other treatment options to help her recover more quickly. Which of the following statements about electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) is TRUE?

options.label: A
options.text: ECT is associated with a high risk of inducing mania in patients with bipolar disorder

options.label: B
options.text: ECT is only effective in treating depressive episodes but not psychotic symptoms

options.label: C
options.text: Unilateral ECT has fewer cognitive side effects than bilateral ECT

options.label: D
options.text: ECT is contraindicated in elderly patients due to an increased risk of cognitive decline
